packaging.directions: Soak it up. For oilier complexions, in humid climates, or with heavy moisturizers, start with an application of Mineral Veil before applying bareMinerals SPF 15 Foundation. Take it to go. Swirl and Tap Mineral Veil into the brush before you leave the house. (For a day-to-evening look, swirl Clear Radiance along with the Mineral Veil.) Put on the cover, pop into your purse, and Buff on your bareMinerals on the go or as an office to evening pick-me-up. Swirl a small amount of Mineral Veil by angling the Flawless Application Face Brush and swirl into the lid until all the Mineral Veil has been tucked into the bristles. Tap away excess. There should be no visible Mineral Veil on the outside of the brush. Buff the Mineral Veil into the skin in a circular motion, starting on the outside of your face near your cheekbone, swirling as you go. Buff around your face and then approach your forehead, cheeks, and nose.

packaging.directions: How to apply: Use a flat top powder brush or kabuki brush for mineral powder foundation application. Take a little of the foundation on the lid of the container, grab some foundation, place the foundation in the areas you need the most coverage. Then go back with the brush and buff the foundation in. Repeat the process till you are happy with the coverage on your face. This will give you a light coverage. For medium coverage, apply wet application.
packaging.warnings: Caution: Avoid inhaling the blush powder dust. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and consult a physician promptly.

packaging.directions: How to apply: Use a flat top powder brush or kabuki brush for mineral powder foundation application. Take a little of the foundation on the lid of the container, grab some foundation, place the foundation in the areas you need the most coverage. Then go back with the brush and buff the foundation in. Repeat the process till you are happy with the coverage on your face. This will give you a light coverage. For medium coverage, apply wet application.
packaging.warnings: Caution: Avoid inhaling the blush powder dust. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and consult a physician promptly.
